findings.title: downloadAllFiles has no test for a failed download
findings.problem: The new downloadAllFiles tests cover no-workspace, success, and both skipped-count-toast cases, but none mock api.downloadFileStream resolving false to exercise the failure path.
findings.impact: isDownloadingAll resetting to false and the method returning false cleanly on a failed/aborted download is currently only guaranteed by the finally block's correctness, not asserted by any test — exactly the path most likely to regress silently under a later refactor.
findings.recommendation: Add a case that mocks downloadFileStream to resolve false and asserts downloadAllFiles() resolves false with isDownloadingAll back to false.

findings.title: downloadAllFiles has no re-entrancy guard
findings.problem: downloadAllFiles only guards on !this.workspace; it has no check on its own isDownloadingAll flag before setting it and firing the request, relying entirely on the UI disabling the button.
findings.impact: A second call before the Valtio snapshot re-renders and disables the button (double-click, or any other caller) kicks off a second overlapping archive-download request for the same workspace.
findings.recommendation: Add `if (this.isDownloadingAll) return false` before setting this.isDownloadingAll = true.
